seoDescription: Find every collectible in Astro's Playroom's GPU Jungle with this complete walkthrough. This guide shows the precise locations of all puzzle pieces and artefacts scattered throughout the four main areas: Render Forest, Teraflop Treetop, Ray Trace Runes, and Mount Motherboard. Follow step-by-step instructions to navigate platforms, solve environmental puzzles, and master the monkey suit controls to uncover every hidden item and unlock the PlayStation 4 artefact for 100% completion of the level.

summary:
## GPU Jungle Collectible Overview
GPU Jungle contains four distinct areas, each with its own set of collectibles:
- **Render Forest**
- **Teraflop Treetop**
- **Ray Trace Runes**
- **Mount Motherboard**

Each of these four areas holds **4 puzzle pieces** and **2 artefacts**.

## Key Mechanics & Tips
- **Blowing into Controller:** Some secrets are hidden behind walls that open when you blow on a pinwheel via the DualSense controller's microphone.
- **Power Spin:** Use Astro's spin attack on large flower-like switches to activate platforms and reveal new paths.
- **Monkey Suit Sections:** Master the L2/R2 climbing controls and the Sixaxis motion controls for movement.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> When in the monkey suit, pay attention to the controller's haptic feedback for **weak handholds**. If you feel strong resistance and see the plastic cracking, ease off the trigger to avoid falling.

- **Explore Hidden Paths:** Many collectibles are found by exploring off the main path. Look for drop-downs, climbable walls, and areas behind checkpoints.
- **Backtracking:** Sometimes you need to reach a checkpoint and then go backward to access a newly visible secret path.


## Area-Specific Collectible Highlights
### Render Forest
- **Artefact 1:** At the very start, drop down to the right to find a hidden cave with a pinwheel.
- **Puzzle Piece 2:** After getting the pullable wire that creates a bomb, look for breakable blocks on the cliffside to the **right** of the main path, not the obvious one ahead.

### Teraflop Treetop
- **Puzzle Piece 1:** During the initial lift into the area, immediately move left to grab a hidden handhold that leads to this piece.
- **Artefact 1:** After swinging to a puzzle piece on the left, climb the **weak handholds** above it to find the artefact. Requires careful trigger control.

### Ray Trace Runes
- **Puzzle Piece 2:** Look and walk directly behind the checkpoint structure after the first centipede enemy.

> [!TIP]
> After the tightrope walk where you get blown by wind, backtrack from the next checkpoint to a flower switch. This opens a path to a puzzle piece and an artefact hidden under breakable glass.

### Mount Motherboard
- **Artefact 1:** After getting a puzzle piece on the left, grab the wire directly underneath it. This starts a **timed sequence** where you must quickly climb weak handholds to get the artefact.
- **Puzzle Pieces 3 & 4:** Fling your monkey suit into a hole on the right wall. One piece is visible, and the second is revealed by pulling **down** on a yellow handhold at the bottom of the cavern.

## Final Artefact
The last artefact in GPU Jungle is the **PlayStation 4**. It is story-related and cannot be missed, obtained by pulling the large blue cable at the very end of the level.

## Render Forest: First Artefact & Puzzle Piece

Welcome back my friends to another trophy guide. This time I'm going to show you all of the collectibles in GPU Jungle. There's four areas, each of them have four puzzle pieces and two artifacts, but we're gonna start things off here in Render Forest. You see the checkpoint just ahead. We are going to actually drop down to the right and find the cave that we can blow into our controller to open up. It's over here in the corner.

Gonna be a little pinwheel here and we're gonna blow into the controller to open up this passageway, grab the wires, and pull up an artifact.

All right, there we go. Now just go ahead and continue the path. Just past the checkpoint, you're going to have a new area off to the left of the platform you can jump onto. There are two enemies up here. Completely eliminate both of these guys, and then we're going to have a little wheel thing that we got to do a power spin.

Okay, there it is. There's a little flower. Power spin. It'll bring up a tree and some platforms. Now from here, it's just going to be easy navigating, uh, three sets of platforms up ahead. You can see the puzzle piece on the top. We're going to jump off, simple platforming.

## Render Forest: Second Puzzle Piece

Okay, just past there, we're gonna jump on these triggers here. See another checkpoint. Now what I'm gonna do is go off the left-hand side. You're going to see there's a wire we can pull right here on this wooden wall. Bounce pad pops out, up to a wire, and then we're going to head to the left. Be careful of these things shooting at you.

Now head back to the center platform here. And what I'm going to do is pull the wire out in front of me. And what you're supposed to do is throw this in the breakable object ahead. Well, we're going to actually look over here to the right, and there are two breakable objects. So we're going to break both of them. This one here on the left will reveal the puzzle piece, and then circle around platform into there and pick it up.

## Render Forest: Final Collectibles

All right, so head back, continue forward. You're eventually going to find this cylinder yellow thing kind of running down on you. Just past it, it's going to be a new area, and we're going to actually go to the left here first. There's a drop-down over here, and please note this bounce pad here because you're going to use this to get back up. But we're going to hop over here, pull the wires, and we're going to get another artifact.

Now you can rejoin the main path using that bounce pad, and then we're going to go off to the right-hand side. Now you're going to see a checkpoint just ahead. To the left of it—there's not actually a checkpoint, it's a bounce pad rather—and just to the left of it is the puzzle piece, which is then going to take you in Teraflop Treetop, which is the monkey section here.

## Teraflop Treetop: First Monkey Suit Collectible

And as you're taking that little chip up, there's a handhold on the left-hand side you need to grab. Grab the next chip and then keep making your way up.

The controls on this can take a minute or two to get used to, but you're basically using your L2 and R2, and then you have to tilt your Sixaxis control. Grab onto that chip and it'll loop you around right into a puzzle piece.

## Teraflop Treetop: Second Puzzle Piece & First Artefact

So we're gonna go from here continue upwards. See we've got another checkpoint here. Now there's a puzzle piece off the left-hand side, so we're gonna swing up to this bar, and we're gonna swing up to this bar... no, not that bar, there we go. And we're gonna make our way over here to the left. There's a puzzle piece. Now there's also some hand holds up to the left, and we're actually going to grab onto those.

Now there's some weak hand holds here, so be careful. With the weak ones you have to pay attention to your feedback, your force feedback on your R2 button here. You don't want to go too far. You'll feel it, which is really, really kind of cool, actually.

Grab that bar to reveal the artifact just above you.

## Teraflop Treetop: Final Area Collectibles

Okay, then we are going to continue the slide, and then up, and then you're going to see the puzzle piece is actually going to be right in your way. It'll be hard to miss that one. I know once you get the puzzle piece, you don't want to continue up. In fact, you can go this way first if you'd like. We need to go up and to the right. You can see there's a hand hold over here. As soon as I get to it, it's going to open up some new area for us.

And just make your way over. You'll get this puzzle piece automatically; your feet will grab it. And then we're going to follow the coins. The coins are going to point you down to another artifact.

## Ray Trace Runes: First Two Puzzle Pieces

And now we're going to head over to Ray Trace Runes, the next area. You're going to be back on your feet. Now at the very start of this area, you're gonna see some wires to the right. Pull that, and then just platform your way up there to the top of it.

And once you've got that, we're going to continue on the path here. Another centipede here. You'll see this checkpoint here; to the left of it, you can actually go behind it. So grab that, pretty well hidden, that one. And just past that, hop on the triggers, bounce pad, and then you're gonna bounce to the left. We're gonna move to the right behind the wires.

## Ray Trace Runes: Hidden Artefact & Puzzle Piece

All right, so at the next checkpoint, I'm going to walk across the wire. You're going to get blown. Don't worry, you're not going to fall off. And you'll have another checkpoint here. At this checkpoint, turn around. We're actually going to backtrack over to this little platform out there in the distance. Power up our spin on this flower, and we reveal a whole bunch of goodies here for you, uh, some coins, but we're trying to get to the puzzle piece. Be careful of this little centipede dude.

And then once we get this collectible, this puzzle piece, there's actually going to be an artifact on the very top as well. We're going to use our thrusters on our feet to destroy the glass here, pull the wires and that's going to be the artifact. And then we have just one more here in Ray Trace Runes, so we're going to get back to the main path.

## Ray Trace Runes: Final Puzzle Piece

This is kind of the, I guess a boss fight if you will. Once you complete it, you'll have a new rope you can walk across. Halfway across, though, turn to your right. You'll see a target. Shoot that target and reveal the puzzle piece.

## Mount Motherboard: First Artefact & Puzzle Piece

Now head over to Mount Motherboard. We're in our monkey suit once again. Let's swing up, and the puzzle piece is going to be off to the left-hand side above us. Now, there's a wire right underneath it. I want to grab that. I got the puzzle piece, and I grabbed the wire. It brings us over here.

Careful of that weak hand hold there, and then just make our way up as quickly as you can, you don't have much time there, and reveal a new artifact, boy.

So we'll kind of go off to the right-hand side as soon as this is over, and then grab that chip. And then you'll see another puzzle piece. This is going to be right in your path too. I don't know if you can miss that one.

## Mount Motherboard: Final Puzzle Pieces

Okay, so we're going to carry on, keep moving. Got another checkpoint. Now you see a puzzle piece is going to be off to the right-hand side there. So what we're going to do is not go this way, Brian. We want to go to the right.

Fling your body into the hole here. There's a few collectibles we're going to get right here. That was the first puzzle piece. The second one is going to be—you have to actually go down and grab this yellow handhold right there, and it'll reveal the puzzle piece. Continue upwards to your next one.

## The Final Artefact & Outro

And there you go. Uh, that's going to be the last one in Mount Motherboard. There is, of course, one final artifact. It's story-related, you can't miss it. And it is for pulling the blue wire at the very end, which is going to reveal the one, the only, PlayStation 4.

I want to thank you guys so much for watching this collectible guide. If you're a trophy hunter, please hit the like button and subscribe.
